hero.subtitle: High-level aesthetic experiences in the heart of Valencia.

philosophy.label: OUR PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.heading: The art of care is learned. The passion to transform comes from within.
philosophy.body: At Lumière Studio we believe that authentic beauty emerges when professional care meets inner wellbeing. Every ritual we offer is designed to awaken your best self, with eco-certified products and cutting-edge techniques.

services.label: SERVICES
services.heading: Rituals designed for every moment.
services.intro: From precision facial treatments to total indulgence body rituals. Every service is an experience designed to transform.

signature.label: EXCLUSIVE RITUAL
signature.heading: The Grand Lumière Ritual
signature.body: Our pinnacle experience: a three-hour sensory journey combining advanced facial cleansing, body massage with first-extraction oils and a nourishing shea butter and gold wrap. Designed for those who deserve the best.

team.label: OUR TEAM
team.heading: Experts in the art of wellbeing.

process.heading: Your experience starts here.
process.step1_desc: Explore our catalogue and select the treatment your body needs.
process.step2_desc: Message us on WhatsApp or use the form. We respond in under 2 hours.
process.step3_desc: You'll receive a confirmation email with all the details of your visit.
process.step4_desc: Arrive 10 minutes early and let go. The rest is our work.
